Update: Jobs watch: weaker hiring can cut both ways for US stocks


A weak jobs headline can ease rate pressure and weaken the earnings outlook at the same time. The S&P 500 needs both sides of that story.


What to watch: A falling yield by itself will not distinguish relief about rates from worry about growth.


Read the full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/jobs-watch-weaker-hiring-can-cut


Analysis, not financial advice. Readers decide whether to trade.

Source: BLS.
